title: Shady's Dark Okami GUI - Farmer's Delight
description: An extension to Shady's Dark Okami GUI that adds support for the Farmer's Delight mod.
body:
In case you happen to be using my "Shady's Dark Okami GUI" pack and you're playing with Farmer's Delight, this pack will extend the dark interface into that mod, along with changing container names white like the base pack. This resource pack supports Farmer's Delight from MC 1.17 and later.

![Farmer's Delight Cooking Pot with a dark UI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/vpTtw9f7/images/abb18440f139facefb3c1c2735e06f614570e0ef.png)

![Farmer's Delight tab on the Advancements page](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/vpTtw9f7/images/52bf9f967d525116c3a73a15099c9e5b13d8c08c.png)
